changelog: v0.1.2-beta: Standalone SQLite music server (/data/brokeify.db), Chokidar /music drive & NAS watcher, and EBU R128 -14 LUFS audio normalizer on Port 3487
Added Connect Android App section with high-contrast QR code, temporary connection token, Copy Server URL button, and link to github.com/Mr-Nickey/brokeify-android
Added Docker Compose & NAS Drive Setup Guide overlay when no audio files are detected in /music
Added HTTP 206 Partial Content byte-range streaming (/api/stream/:trackId) and disk-cached cover art (/api/covers/:albumId)
